subject: Oceanography
title: Arctic Amplification
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Arctic Amplification.

hook.text: The Arctic is warming nearly four times faster than the global average—the fastest warming on Earth.

buildup.text: As ice melts, dark ocean absorbs more sunlight—which melts more ice, which exposes more ocean.

discovery.text: This ice-albedo feedback is the main driver—ice reflects 80% of sunlight; open water absorbs 94%.

twist.text: Arctic amplification doesn't stay in the Arctic—it weakens the jet stream, sending polar air into mid-latitudes.

climax.text: Extreme cold snaps in Texas and heat waves in Europe may be linked to Arctic ice loss.

punchline.text: What happens in the Arctic doesn't stay in the Arctic.

quiz.question: What drives Arctic amplification?
options: The ice-albedo feedback: less ice means more heat absorbed
